topic: Turning Fitness Tracking into a Retention Tool

facts.label: Story
facts.value: Turning Fitness Tracking into a Retention Tool

facts.label: Outlet
facts.value: Club Solutions

facts.label: Article
facts.value: Wearables and fitness tracking give operators new ways to personalize coaching, boost member engagement and improve retention. Members have more access to their fitness data than ever before. With a glance at their wrist or a few taps on their phone, they can see how hard they worked and if their performance has changed over time. As the information becomes part of everyday fitness routines, health clubs have an opportunity to turn those insights into a more personalized and engaging member experience. Wearable technology and fitness tracking give operators additional ways to support members’ goals and demonstrate the progress being made inside their facilities. From real-time coaching to ongoing motivation, the information members collect can help clubs deliver more meaningful experiences while strengthening the relationships that encourage them to return. At Orangetheory Fitness and Crunch Fitness, tracking technology has become part of how members engage with their workouts and measure success. By making fitness data accessible and actionable, both brands are helping members better understand their progress while giving their teams additional tools to support them. For Orangetheory, wearable technology helps members understand how their bodies respond to exercise in real time.

facts.value: FitLab Files for Bankruptcy

facts.label: Outlet
facts.value: Fitt Insider

facts.label: Deal
facts.value: shutdown

facts.label: Article
facts.value: Big swing. What’s happening: The multi-brand fitness platform filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy, reporting $100M–500M in liabilities to 1K–5K creditors. House money. Founded in 2019, FitLab sought to unify studios, experiences, and equipment in an integrated Performance Lifestyle platform, using M&A of high-profile brands for rapid growth. Notable acquisitions included adventure race Ragnar , equipment maker Assault Fitness , yoga chain Y7 Studio , and run studio Mile High Run Club — with it also powering Laird Hamilton/Gabby Reece’s XPT and, most notably, Nike Studios . Shuttered. Earlier this year, reports of high churn, rising debt, and race cancellations emerged. Nike ended its deal before partnering with The Yard Gym months later. Assault shipments stopped. MHRC and Y7 closed all studios. As the courts sort through the claims, an outside investment group is funding Ragnar’s scheduled calendar en route to acquisition, while [solidcore] founder Anne Mahlum paid Y7 instructors’ missing payroll. Looking ahead: Taking a big swing, unifying diverse, operationally complex businesses was a compelling concept that proved difficult to execute, serving as a cautionary tale for sweeping roll-ups. Drei Doppel-Courts und ein Single-Court sind nun online buchbar. Am vergangenen Wochenende ist der aktivpark padel club offiziell gestartet. Gemeinsam mit Partnern, Freunden, Familie und Gästen feierte der Club seine Eröffnung. Auf den Courts standen sportlicher Ehrgeiz, neue Erfahrungen und eine offene Atmosphäre im Mittelpunkt. Für den Spielbetrieb gibt es im aktivpark padel club drei Doppel-Courts und einen Single-Court. Die AFP Panoramacourts von Adidas bieten Bedingungen für schnelle Ballwechsel. Padel verbindet Elemente aus Tennis und Squash. Gespielt wird auf einem Court, der von Glas- und Gitterwänden umgeben ist. Diese Wände gehören zum Spiel dazu. Sie ermöglichen schnelle Ballwechsel und verschiedene taktische Spielzüge. Bei Trainings für Erwachsene und Kinder konnten die Gäste die Grundlagen kennenlernen und erste Erfahrungen sammeln. Ein Landesligaturnier des Deutschen Padel Verbands (DPV) sorgte für spannende Spiele.
